title: $q$-middle Laplace transform and its applications
summary: We introduce a $q$-analog of the one-variable middle Laplace transform defined by the first author. We establish its invertibility and preservation of irreducibility, and derive a decomposition of $q$-middle convolution in terms of this transform. As applications, we obtain integral representations of solutions to the confluent $q$-hypergeometric equation and its variant, and construct a transformation of the $2\times 2$ Lax linear equation associated with the $q$-Painlevé equation of type $A_4^{(1)}$.
